profile.legalName: Lend A Hand Foundation Inc Of Northern California
profile.summary: A nonprofit based in Oakland, California, that supports underserved children, youth and families in Alameda County and the Bay Area. It provides educational support, health and wellness resources, and basic needs such as school supplies and clothing. Its programs include a yearly back-to-school supply giveaway and the Stay In School program.
